purpose: Descriptive market and cost anatomy before signal implementation; no strategy replay
exposure: Strictly inside previously exposed training; no validation/holdout outcome queries
sampling: Last quote at each exact UTC minute; freshness <=2000ms by source timestamp, not measured receipt
session_buckets: Existing versioned Tokyo/London/New York local-weekday conventions, disjoint overlaps
metrics: absolute subsequent 15-minute mid-price change and endpoint spread cost

eurusd_endpoint_diagnostic.returns: mid change and exit bid minus entry ask, pips; fees/slippage/financing unmeasured and omitted
eurusd_endpoint_diagnostic.split: three consecutive blocks of 25 expected weekdays
eurusd_endpoint_diagnostic.uncertainty: 5000 fixed-seed resamples of observed ISO-week clusters; percentile interval for daily mean
eurusd_endpoint_diagnostic.scope: All valid weekday endpoints, no calendar veto/stop/target/risk sizing; not executable strategy or independent validation
